name: Toronto Empathy Questionnaire
instruction: Below is a list of statements. Please read each statement carefully and rate how frequently you feel or act that way (0 = Never, 1 = Rarely, 2 = Sometimes, 3 = Often, 4 = Always).

items.text: When someone else is feeling excited, I tend to get excited too.
Other people's misfortunes do not disturb me a great deal.
It upsets me to see someone being treated disrespectfully.
I remain unaffected when someone close to me is happy.
I enjoy making other people feel better.
I have tender, concerned feelings for people less fortunate than me.
When a friend starts to talk about his/her problems, I try to steer the conversation to something else.
I can tell when others are sad even when they do not say anything.
I find that I am 'in tune' with other people's moods.
I do not feel sympathy for people who cause their own serious problems.
I become irritated when someone cries.
I am not really interested in how other people feel.
I get a strong urge to help when I see someone who is upset.
When I see someone being taken advantage of, I feel kind of protective towards them.
I can easily empathize with what characters in a book or movie are feeling.
I am interested in other people's problems.
